text:
marta: Heads up — p99 latency spike on g5x (us-west) after the driver micro-patch this morning. Observed autoselect switching away from flash_attn_v2 to triton_gemm_fallback on short seqs. p99 +120ms.

lucas: also seeing throughput drop ~18% on mixed batch lanes (1/8/32). Affects services with KV prefetch on.

marta: deploy-bot shows the driver bump (535.86) rolled at 07:12. Not all pools affected, seems correlated with triton runtime update too.

deploy-bot: deployed driver 535.86 and triton-runtime 2.8.1 to pool gpu-pool-us-west-2 at 2025-11-03T07:12:08Z :rocket:

cheng: any kernel selector logs or dmesg hints? noisy PCIe or NVLink resets?

marta: no OOMs. quick dmesg snippet: `NVLINK: subsystem reset on GPU 23`, but only a few lines. not sure that's causal.

devon: can you run the repro? `python infra/perf_repro.py --model gpt-small --batches 1,8,32 --seq 16 --kv-prefetch-on` then capture `nsys profile --output spike.nsys python ...`

marta: ran repro, attaching trimmed nsys timeline:
```
Time(ms)  Event                    Duration(ms)
--------- ------------------------ -------------
0         flash_attn_kernel_v2     4.2
10        MemcpyHtoD                18.3  <-- big
30        triton_gemm               22.1
55        MemcpyDtoH                10.9
```
Observation: large HtoD copy right before triton_gemm + more kernel runtime overall.

lucas: interesting — kernel selector log shows it switched because workspace_estimate > 256MB, so it avoided flash_attn to dodge workspace alloc thrash. selector log peek: 
```
[kernel_selector] model=gpt-small seq=16 batch=8 chosen=triton_gemm est_workspace=312MB reason=kv_prefetch_enabled
```

cheng: so enabling KV prefetch increases the estimated workspace (prefetch pinned memory pages?) and triggers the selector heuristic. That explains why only services with kv_prefetch=true see this.

devon: quick mitigation: we can override selector heuristic in the serving config to prefer flash_attn_v2 for seq<=64 on g5x. I'll push a canary.

marta: canary config applied to 5% of traffic now for gpu-pool-us-west-2. early numbers look better — p99 back down ~30ms.

lucas: created a short-term rule: if est_workspace > 256MB but seq <= 64 and kv_prefetch=true, prefer flash_attn_v2. This is a bandaid until we fix workspace estimator.

cheng: long-term: we should adjust workspace estimator in the triton adapter to account for streaming KV prefetch (we're double-counting reserved workspace). I'll open a PR to fix calculation.

devon: noted. also filing INF-4321 with repro steps, nsys trace, selector logs, and the canary config we applied.

marta: thanks. next actions: 1) keep canary running for 4 hours, 2) roll the selector override to 25% then 100% if stable, 3) cheng to lead estimator fix PR, 4) retro to follow up on driver vs triton release coordination. :white_check_mark:

lucas: pinging @infra on possible NVLink noise — we'll keep monitoring but prioritizing selector fix.

devon: updated ticket INF-4321 with links and pinned workaround config. will post a retro summary later.

marta: nice work team. Thanks for the quick turnaround :thumbsup:
